title: Large personal Amiga, Atari ST, CPC and DOS discovery pass
summary: Personally screen 350 unique URLs from 390 search hits; review 42 repository roots, add 33 projects, consolidate seven forks and exclude two unsupported game claims.
notes: Root assistant performed this discovery and publication personally, without a worker, PR or new branch. Nine fresh searches covered Amiga, Atari ST, CPC, BBC, Spectrum and Commodore sources and tools. Known entries and unrelated substring hits were screened before deeper inspection. Seven fork parents were verified against existing catalogue records. Hardware-specific source restorations, original homebrew, native remakes, educational projects and development tools are distinguished. Build limitations include missing assets, documented crashes, tokenized source, untested parsers and historical compiler requirements. No upstream code, bundled executable, game, ROM or disk image was run; source review is not independent build/runtime verification. Two connector-decoded non-UTF-8 texts are referenced by pinned URLs but deliberately excluded from inline proofs because their bytes could not be verified. Remaining proof blobs are hash-verified before sealing.

Collection of historical French ST Magazine assembly and GFA BASIC examples, including concrete low-level graphics routines.

Preserved pre-release demo source plus a substantive converter from Turbo Assembler syntax to rmac-compatible generated assembly.

Normal and minimal assembly entry templates handle basepage/section setup and reusable equates.

Browser remake attempt of an older Amstrad homebrew game, with canvas world/player rendering, keyboard handling and physics-related modules.
Native PCW implementation of the 2048 puzzle, with board movement, score, random tiles and screen assets.
Shogi game with moves/drops, promotions, clocks, save/load and CSA game history. Separate historical Turbo Pascal and modern Free Pascal sources.
Game-jam source includes keyboard control, movement/jump tables, collision, enemies, projectiles and HUD modules with authored sprite assets.
Spanish text-adventure prototype with command parsing, history, rooms and action dispatch, alongside a documented map.
Single-player CPC 464 game where a ghost helps investigators collect keys within a time limit. Reviewed ghost, human and trap state implementation.
Oh Mummy-inspired remake with world/sprite/crypt structures and collision/game-state routines, written for a seven-day Lisp challenge.
Substantial native Oh Mummy adaptation with keyboard scanning, sound jump tables, object maps and Plus sprite support.
Extends RobertK’s Hercules Tron game to CGA/EGA/VGA and GEM, with Amstrad PC 1512/1640 joystick support.
Progressive readable STOS listings reconstruct Willy movement, jumping, maps and tile collision.
C900 BIOS reconstruction and extension work with boot/filesystem/diagnostic code and historical COHERENT compiler wrappers.
Annotated 6502 demo listing explains nibble transfers, character indexing and user-port signaling to the PCG-6500 graphics board.
Hands-on TED-system guide with native samples, PRG header/dump/old-byte-checked patch operations, container triage and Ghidra register naming helpers.
Parses Amiga Hunk headers, data/code/BSS, relocations, symbols and debug records into a structural report.
ISO9660 layout and path-table helpers add CD32 application data and trademark boot metadata to prepared images.
Browser image quantization/dithering and palette adjustment with worker-based processing. Inspected 9-bit, 12-bit and 24-bit color handling.
Reads Sonic Arranger songs, voices, notes and instruments, including files with embedded replay code, for MIDI conversion.
AFFS structure checker and formatter, with bitmap consistency logic and verbose filesystem inspection.
RDB information and device-to-stream/stream-to-device utilities with modernized 64-bit offsets, TD64/NSD support and overflow safeguards.
Converts Stunts 1.1 DOS custom-car geometry and parameters into Amiga 4D Sports Driving 1.2 representations. Reviewed vector/primitive serialization.
Interactive gradient interpolation/dithering tool exports palette tables, big-endian binary and Amiga Copper lists, with ST/STE/Falcon format encoders.
Converts IFF images to raw interleaved/non-interleaved data and binary or assembly palettes, with decompression support.
Native benchmark harness with timer.device/EClock timing, system information and compiler-specific support for GCC, SAS/C and vbcc.
Reads and modifies Amiga .info DiskObject/Gadget fields, tool types/default tools, and embedded normal/selected icon graphics via PNG.

Documented historical MIDI utility provides channel/patch control, thru, panic, metronome, channel mapping and monitor modes. Original GFA file, GEM resources and compiled program/accessory are retained.
